assertions.statement: 4A2R names RA95.5-5 and cites Giger2013 DOI10.1038/nchembio.1276. Its full 258-residue canonical sequence is distinct from coordinate coverage and reference/scaffold annotation.

Both covale records attach Lys83 NZ to 3NK C13, separately for ligand A/B. Both have unknown pdbx_value_order and leaving flag one. The complete connection inventory contains no Lys210 ligand attachment; this is not a general absence of Lys210 chemistry.

3NK names the free 1,3-diketone with formula C15 H14 O3; its dictionary has C13=ONA while coordinate alternatives both omit ONA. Retain the typed attachment endpoints and source-described vinylogous amide separately from an unresolved complete reacted bond-order/protonation graph. Do not complete that graph by dropping ONA and joining unchanged component dictionaries.

3NK has two alternatives A/B at occupancy0.67/0.33; each has31 coordinate atoms including17heavy atoms. Lys83 and Lys210 NZ are nonalternate at occupancy1.00. These occupancies do not supply solution populations or activity fractions.
